errors.product_name: Enter the product's commercial name (up to {{max}} characters).
errors.support_date: The end-of-support date must be YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason of at least {{min}} characters; it stays on record.
errors.reason_too_long: The reason can be up to {{max}} characters, with no control characters.
errors.unknown_event: That event doesn't exist or is no longer a KEV match on a product.
errors.not_reopenable: Only an event marked as not affecting the product can be reopened.
errors.not_exploited: Record that it's actively exploited in your product before marking what you sent.
errors.disabled: CRA reporting is off. An admin can turn it on in Policies.

policy.migrated: Turned on automatically: products were already marked before this setting existed.

vex.false_positive: Dismissed in triage as a false positive.

sbom.needs_full_scan: The SBOM comes from a full analysis that has finished: this one isn't.
sbom.origin: Trivy inventory of the analyzed manifests and lockfiles. No supplier or hash per component: they aren't inferred.
sbom.origin_image: Trivy inventory of the analyzed manifests and lockfiles and of the image's system packages. No supplier or hash per component: they aren't inferred.
